description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (RP2350, Cortex-M33), NobroRTOS portable-core port over USB-CDC with self-DFU to BOOTSEL

firmware_generation.entry: rp235x-hal entry plus mandatory IMAGE_DEF blocks
firmware_generation.interrupts: owned by the maintained RP2350 port and its selected provider features
firmware_generation.dma: DMA completion is an explicit port feature with channel and IRQ ownership
firmware_generation.clock: rp235x-hal board startup owns PLL and timer configuration
firmware_generation.boot: ROM IMAGE_DEF scanning and BOOTSEL recovery are owned by the maintained port
